name: Indian trumpet fruit
summary: The núc nác fruit, faintly bitter and easy to eat.
taste: Báo Sơn La says faintly bitter.
where: The highland table. A street was not named.
seoTitle: Nuc nac in Son La — faintly bitter fruit
seoDescription: Quả núc nác in Sơn La. Báo Sơn La calls the dish faintly bitter.
